payload.title: Regime-specialized coefficient experts
payload.statement: After the E011 notebook run is reviewed, split-local legal regime experts may recover additional nonlinear coefficient accuracy on demonstrably distinct well regimes while a confidence gate falls back exactly to the strongest verified global path.
payload.evidence_for: Two preimplementation screens tested 226 hard, soft, local, latent, and partial-pooled specialist branches. The formal nested KNN branch found a tiny 0.013698 RMSE signal and improved all three special slices.
payload.evidence_against: No worth-screen branch improved pooled RMSE. Formal E012 completed nine representative branches over 25 repeated and 10 stress contexts; the best KNN branch won only 15/25 cells, missed the 0.05 gain floor, and regressed spatial groups 0/1 and typewell group 0.
payload.next_test: Closed by E012. Do not retune regimes, KNN neighborhoods, latent routing, or partial pooling around E011. Reopen only if a genuinely new legal mechanism supplies independently validated routing evidence.
